title: Coda Desktop MCP Event System and Offline Mode
description: Introduce an event system so coda desktop updates whenever the MCP server produces events. Desktop must show every event with all information. Desktop must work without MCP server. All agent-output calls (translate, validate, fix) must allow manual input of results.
summary: Implemented complete event system connecting coda desktop (Electron) and coda MCP sidecar. Python sidecar: added 6 missing methods, fixed return shapes for 5 methods. Electron main: event forwarding, connection tracking, MCP response wrapping, removed duplicate handlers. Preload: event/connection listener bridges. Renderer: EventsPage with filtering, connection indicator, manual input for translate/validate/fix per target, offline error handling.
